{{SameName|Papa Bread|[[Papa Bread (Village of Despair)|Village of Despair]] • [[Papa Bread (Cold Ambush)|Cold Ambush]] • [[Papa Bread (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus Frosthold]]}} {{EventEnded|date = 4th of February 2023|event = [[Violent Night Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Papa Bread |image1 = papabreadthesequel.png |mode_appearance = [[Violent Night Event|Violent Night]] |first_wave_appearance = 23 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]2,400 |defense = {{Defense}}50% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Health]]Below Average (2.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Energy}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Papa Bread''' was an enemy that debuted on Wave 23 exclusively in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It was a tanky enemy with an below average speed, which could be quite dangerous on Waves ??? and ❄️ because of its health increasing exponentially quite quickly. It also could not be stunned by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]], instead it could only be slowed down by them. ==Appearance== '''Papa Bread''' was a dark brown gingerbread man with a festive pattern apron, a festive chef's hat and a brown wooden ladle strapped on its back. Its rig had a waist and lower arms. Its cylindrical head consisted of a smile and two eyes made from icing. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. *The [[Commander]] can be quite useful at decreasing the firerate of your towers. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be helpful by increasing the range of your towers and decreasing their upgrade costs. *The [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can only slow '''Papa Bread''' instead of stunning it, due to its [[Energy Immunity]]. **The [[Freezer]], [[Sledger]] and [[Frost Blaster]] can freeze '''Papa Bread''', though they can only do so for a shorter amount of time because of its size. *Defense dropping towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]], can be very useful at decreasing the high defense of this enemy, allowing your towers to deal more damage. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} PapaBreadWalk.gif|Walking animation (21 December 2022 – 4 February 2023) }} ==Trivia== *While this enemy has the same name as [[Papa Bread (Village of Despair)|Papa Bread]] from [[Village of Despair]], the only similarity between these enemies is them being gingerbread men. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Papa Bread''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Papa Bread''' removed. {{ColdAmbush2|[[Gatekeeper (Cold Ambush)|Gatekeeper]]
